High-Density Interlocking I/O

SENSIO

SENSIO offers robust and high-performance solutions for efficient input reading and output delivery to the main electronic interlocking system. Designed with a lightning-fast response cycle of 200ms, it ensures rapid and precise gear automation.

448 I/O Capacity
Scalable modular design handling up to 448 inputs/outputs per unit.
10A High Load Output
Heavy-duty relay output cards engineered for demanding point machines.
Ethernet Networking
Interconnects multiple station cabins seamlessly over industrial Ethernet.
Automatic Diagnostics
Self-testing algorithms verifying signal health and route commands.

Automatic Factory Acceptance Testing

SENTRIS

SENTRIS is a powerful automated validation engine designed to maximize efficiency, accuracy, and reliability during the testing of electronic interlocking application logic. By automatically testing data against predefined rules and test cases, SENTRIS eliminates hundreds of manual testing hours and human errors.

  • Zonal Adaptability: Customizes to all 18 Indian Railway Zonal practices with minimal input configuration.
  • Comprehensive Audit Trails: Generates instant CRS-ready reports and square sheet validations.
Station Master Training Environment

SENS Traffic Simulator

Our Train Simulator Software replicates real-life station and block operations for Station Masters and Traffic Controllers. Featuring on-screen block instruments and automatic block sections, it provides comprehensive operational immersion.

Instructors can inject track failures, signal blanking, point flash, and emergency scenarios to evaluate and grade trainee response in real-time.

Trackside GIS

SENS Cable Tracker

A tailor-made GIS software for Indian Railways to effortlessly identify, route-trace, and core-verify signalling cables across junctions and stations. Records initiation point, track crossings, location boxes, and termination points with pinpoint precision.

Algorithmic Circuit Generation

SENS Algen & L2L

Employs algorithmic safety rules to automatically generate interlocking circuits and Boolean logic equations. Eliminates manual drafting errors and dramatically accelerates project delivery for Indian Railway zonal yards.
